attention_reservoir.reason: All new mechanisms currently live as callable library functions/tests. QL3 itself says that is not server enforcement. The strongest blocker is therefore self-referential: the lifecycle is THREAD/TEST SCAFFOLDED until existing admission boundaries actually invoke it.

claim: Governance can mature from consistency checking into a non-authoritative qualification lifecycle composed from existing PCMMAD owners.

csc.finding: The campaign successfully derived richer lifecycle distinctions, but promoting them as server governance now would violate its own scaffolding law. process_effect remains syntactic-semantic evidence, not proof that Research OS changed decisions causally.

earned.law: AUTHORITY CHANGE != EVIDENCE INVALIDATION; load-bearing binding changes create requalification debt.
QUALIFICATION IS QUERY + CONSEQUENCE + SCOPE RELATIVE.
CAMPAIGN CONCLUSION REQUIRES CURRENT-BINDING REAUTHORIZATION BEFORE PROMOTION.
CREDIBLE COUNTEREVIDENCE -> DOCTRINE_CHALLENGE, not suppression or automatic doctrine override.
NEGATIVE EVIDENCE requires scope + reopen condition; semantic delta preserves unknown endpoints; closure escape justifies search not primitives; research depth is consequence/reserve-relative.

helix_next: Reopen by selecting one existing natural consequence boundary (fresh rehydration or promotion/checkpoint seal), integrating the lifecycle there without new authority, then prove ordinary-path enforcement from a virgin caller. Do not wire every tool call and do not call library availability enforcement.
